clusters.headline: Union Cabinet Clears Amended Delimitation Bill For Special Session
aiSummaryBullets: The Union Cabinet approved a new version of the Delimitation Bill, which includes provisions for women's reservation.
The proposed legislation seeks to increase Lok Sabha seats across all states while keeping current seat ratios frozen until 2051.

clusters.headline: Supreme Court Orders Karthigai Deepam Lighting at Tirupparankundram
aiSummaryBullets: The Supreme Court intervened following complaints of non-compliance regarding the ritual lighting of the Karthigai Deepam at Tirupparankundram hill.
Legal proceedings have intensified due to disputes between temple authorities and local stakeholders regarding the execution of the tradition.

clusters.headline: Bombay High Court Cancels Gift Deed In Property Dispute Over Care
aiSummaryBullets: The Bombay High Court ruled that a father may reclaim a gifted flat if the recipient fails to provide agreed-upon maintenance.
The court invalidated the gift deed, confirming the father's lifetime right to reside in the property.

clusters.headline: Supreme Court Orders Karthigai Deepam To Be Lit At Deepathoon
aiSummaryBullets: The Supreme Court mandated that the Karthigai Deepam lamp be lit at the designated Deepathoon site.
The court suspended the temple's board of trustees and appointed receivers to manage the temple operations.

clusters.headline: Sunjay Kapur Family Trust Mediation Fails In Ongoing Asset Dispute
aiSummaryBullets: Court-mandated mediation efforts to resolve the long-standing family trust dispute have concluded without an agreement.
The legal conflict involves Sunjay Kapur and centers on assets valued at approximately Rs 30,000 crore.

clusters.headline: Political Clash Intensifies Across India On Constitution Day
aiSummaryBullets: The BJP and Congress engaged in mutual accusations of undermining constitutional values during commemorations.
Union Minister Amit Shah criticized Congress leadership regarding the status of the Women's Reservation Bill.

clusters.headline: Supriya Sule Skips INDIA Bloc Meet Over Sharad Pawar Health Issues
aiSummaryBullets: Supriya Sule announced she will miss the current INDIA bloc meeting due to Sharad Pawar being hospitalised.
The NCP MP stated she plans to travel to Delhi on November 30 to participate in the upcoming special Parliament session.

clusters.headline: At Least 24 People Killed In Bus-Truck Collision In Assam State
aiSummaryBullets: A collision involving a bus and a truck occurred in Assam, India.
The incident resulted in at least 24 confirmed fatalities.

clusters.headline: Supreme Court Criticizes Tamil Nadu CM Joseph Vijay On Deepathoon
aiSummaryBullets: The Supreme Court criticized the Tamil Nadu government regarding a recent Deepathoon order.
State BJP officials have requested an apology from Chief Minister Joseph Vijay following the court ruling.

clusters.headline: Punjab Congress Critiques Revived BJP And Shiromani Akali Dal Pact
aiSummaryBullets: Punjab Congress president Pargat Singh predicted the BJP and Shiromani Akali Dal alliance would secure only single-digit seats.
Opposition figures cited historical grievances, including the farmers' protest and religious concerns, as reasons for public discontent.

clusters.headline: Kerala High Court Issues Rulings On Multiple High-Profile Cases
aiSummaryBullets: A Division Bench of the Kerala High Court heard an appeal regarding the suspension of 16 Students’ Federation of India members from SSUS.
Three individuals affiliated with the BJP-RSS were sentenced to life imprisonment for the 2016 murder of a CPI(M) leader in Kerala.

clusters.headline: Sensex And Nifty Surge As Foreign Investment Boosts Market Today
aiSummaryBullets: The BSE Sensex rose by over 2,000 points while the Nifty50 index surpassed the 25,800 mark.
Market growth was primarily supported by substantial foreign capital inflows into technology and private banking stocks.

clusters.headline: Supreme Court Grants Bail To AAP Leader Naresh Balyan And Others
aiSummaryBullets: The Supreme Court of India granted bail to former AAP MLA Naresh Balyan in connection with an organized crime case.
A bench of Justices Vikram Nath and Aparesh Kumar Singh issued the bail order after reviewing a challenge to a Delhi High Court decision.

clusters.headline: Supreme Court Quashes Bihar Move To Release Anand Mohan From Prison
aiSummaryBullets: The Supreme Court annulled the Bihar government's decision to grant premature release to former MP Anand Mohan.
Justices Dipankar Datta and Sheel Nagu ruled that the state's modification of prison regulations for his early exit was unconstitutional.

clusters.headline: Nandini Curd Price Reduced In Karnataka Following Public Backlash
aiSummaryBullets: The retail price for Nandini curd has been lowered by Rs 2 per kilogram.
The adjustment follows reports of public dissatisfaction regarding earlier cost increases.

clusters.headline: Congress And Samajwadi Party Face Friction Over Uttar Pradesh Seats
aiSummaryBullets: Seat-sharing negotiations between Congress and the Samajwadi Party in Uttar Pradesh remain deadlocked amid internal disputes.
The Samajwadi Party released a manifesto focused on youth, employment, and agricultural issues while facing criticism from other political figures.

clusters.headline: High Court Rules Against Ritabrata Banerjee In West Bengal Post
aiSummaryBullets: The Calcutta High Court nullified the appointment of Ritabrata Banerjee as the Leader of the Opposition in West Bengal.
This judicial decision is reported as a significant development for Chief Minister Mamata Banerjee and the Trinamool Congress.

clusters.headline: India Rejects US Manufacturing Claims Amid New Trade Tariff Threats
aiSummaryBullets: The United States has proposed a 25% tariff on Indian goods following a trade probe into manufacturing capacity.
Indian officials have officially denied allegations of excess manufacturing capacity in domestic sectors.

clusters.headline: Centre Confirms Look Out Circular Issued Against Saurav Das
aiSummaryBullets: The Indian government confirmed to the Delhi High Court that a Look Out Circular has been issued against Saurav Das.
Authorities stated that document discrepancies, specifically concerning a passport, may impact his citizenship status.

clusters.headline: Supreme Court Quashes Case Against Rahul Gandhi Over Asset Claims
aiSummaryBullets: The Supreme Court of India canceled Allahabad High Court directives that had requested probes by the CBI and ED into Rahul Gandhi's assets.
Rahul Gandhi recently alleged that his father, Rajiv Gandhi, had his security protection intentionally removed to facilitate his assassination.
